title: Linear Strategic Classification with Endogenous Improvements
abstract: arXiv:2606.01198v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Classical models of strategic classification treat agents' responses to a deployed classifier as cosmetic: features change, but true labels do not. We study an improvement-aware variant in which strategic responses can change outcomes: agents choose post-deployment features strategically at a cost, and labels are then drawn from a fixed conditional outcome law. We formalize this problem for linear classifiers under a single-index qualification model and linear-decomposable costs. Under these assumptions, agents' best responses reduce to a closed-form shift of the decision boundary, and the resulting improvement-aware classification problem is learnable with linear sample complexity. As post-deployment labels are unavailable a priori, we begin by establishing a generalization bound with oracle access to the outcome law. translated_title: 具有内生改进的线性策略性分类
translated_abstract: 经典的策略性分类模型将智能体对已部署分类器的响应视为表面行为：特征会改变，但真实标签不会改变。我们研究了一种改进感知的变体，其中策略性响应可以真正改变结果：智能体以一定代价策略性地选择部署后的特征，随后标签从一个固定的条件结果律中抽取。我们在单指标资格模型和线性可分解代价的假设下，为线性分类器形式化了这一问题。在这些假设下，智能体的最优响应可以简化为决策边界的闭式偏移，由此产生的改进感知分类问题可以以线性样本复杂度进行学习。由于部署后的标签无法先验获得，我们首先在可以访问结果律预言机的条件下建立了泛化界。我们的主要贡献之一是一个实用的插入式算法，该算法用估计值代替预言机，以及……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文研究了策略性分类的改进感知变体，证明在单指标资格模型和线性可分解代价下，智能体的最优响应可简化为决策边界的闭式偏移，该问题具有线性样本复杂度的可学习性，并提出了一个用估计代替预言机的实用插入式算法。
en_tdlr: This paper studies an improvement-aware variant of strategic classification where strategic responses can genuinely change outcomes, proving that under a single-index qualification model and linear-decomposable costs, agents' best responses reduce to a closed-form decision boundary shift, the problem is learnable with linear sample complexity, and proposing a practical plug-in algorithm that replaces the oracle with an estimate.
